assembly_coordinate_system.origin_name: southwest tile centre of complete construction rectangle
assembly_coordinate_system.conversion: display X = authoring east metres / 16 + 7; display Y = authoring north metres / 16 + 13

assembly_coordinate_system.display_axes: X increases east/right; Y increases north/up on the north-up plan
